title: Causal Nonseparability and Environmental Objectivity: Reproducibility Package
description: Reproducibility package supporting the manuscript Causal Nonseparability and Environmental Objectivity: Independence, Control-Assisted Records, and Quantum-Switch Benchmarks. The package contains analytic certificates, statevector validation, reduced-normal-form checks, finite-shot ideal-sampling outputs, claim-to-artifact traceability, and checksum manifests. The manuscript establishes logical independence between environmental objectivity and causal nonseparability, and separates redundant environmental records from control-assisted joint-access information.
